correctness.rationale: Every point has <=2 free adjacent coordinates. Cubical counts give χ(X_n)=(4−n)2^(n−2). A nonidentity index rotation fixes only periodic cube vertices (2^gcd sign patterns); a reflection fixes precisely disjoint circles, so its χ=0. The local finite-isometry quotient of the surface is a surface; a generic mirror point gives nonempty boundary. Burnside χ then gives 1−r_n, and the bordered-surface spine theorem gives free pi_1 of rank r_n and full integral homotopy type. For odd n, reflections are rotation-conjugate and the fixed-locus projection into cyclic quotient is injective, proving 2^((n−3)/2) boundary components. The independent simplex-orbit verifier agrees for n=5..10; finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full dihedral ordinary quotient transforms a genus-r_n closed cyclic quotient into a compact bordered surface with free fundamental group F_{r_n}; its second homology vanishes whereas that of the cyclic quotient does not. The mirror-circle count for odd polygons captures the geometric cause and a boundary invariant absent from the known cyclic genus formula. This is a uniform, naturally motivated group-action topology distinction, not a new claim about the previously computed genus alone.
